commits.message:
perf(p2): preserve strict canonical semantics while reducing repeated checks

Keep exact native types, UTF-8 validation, safe integer bounds, JSON bytes and first-error order. Differential checks against frozen source include 500 generated nested inputs and explicit invalid types; 171 unit/contract and 41 PostgreSQL focused tests pass. Eight paired same-world query comparisons preserve complete payload, evidence and cut material with measured 5.72% median improvement, without a capacity claim.

Reject the slower Schema memo candidate and retain its negative evidence. Preserve all 20 first-checkpoint capacity measurements and four verified JUnit files with hashes beyond Actions retention. The first checkpoint passed 436 full PostgreSQL tests, but original hot/1000-RPS capacity gates remain NOT_MET; both PRs stay Draft.
